build_WholeFish_model: build a WholeFish model with a given input shape, number of classes, and hyperparameters dict
create_Featurizer: create a Featurizer auto-selecting MLP, MNIST_CNN, ResNet, or DinoV2 based on input shape and hparams
create_Classifier: create a linear or nonlinear Classifier module mapping in_features to out_features
build_ResNet_network: build a ResNet feature extractor with frozen batchnorm and optional channel adaptation
build_DinoV2_network: build a DinoV2 ViT feature extractor using intermediate layers with optional attention tuning
